title: ORION Inference Ledger Record v1
description: One inference, one row. Answers what it cost and whether it worked. It is NOT a transcript: no prompt or completion text may ever appear here. This machine holds health and financial data, and a ledger that quietly became a conversation log would be a privacy regression, not a feature.

tokens.description: Absent counts are null, never zero. A model that reports no token count did not use none.

estimated_cost_usd.description: null when the role declares no rates. Distinguishable from 0.0, which means a real inference that genuinely cost nothing.

failure_reason.description: A bounded, log-safe reason code or short message. Never a stack trace, never model output.

context_tokens.description: Prompt size at call time. This is what makes 'apply least-context principles' auditable instead of a claim.

source.description: Which ORION surface performed the inference. A fact about ORION's own shape, so it survives a change of router.

executor.description: Who actually routed and made the provider call. Separate from `source` on purpose: if ORION ever outgrows OpenClaw and takes routing in-house, only this field changes, and the ledger itself becomes the proof of the migration -- the day rows stop saying openclaw and start saying orion_router.
